fields.name: type
fields.description: The thing to interact with. It selects the variant. Leave it out for a konami `key`. Any other value (or none) with no `key` gets no reply.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Changes some replies: see each variant. The cave and cavalry replies always copy it. With it, `citizen_route`, `newyear_tree` and `the_lever` also send a `data` reply on success, and their `distance` failure (except for `citizen_route`) is an object.

request.others: ignored, except the fields of the variant. The whole payload can also be the string `"the_lever"` (the variant **Lever (bare)**)

confirm.note: `data.type` picks the branch; `request_id` is read once, and a falsy one counts as none

variants.intro: `cave` and `cavalry` match with `===`, the others with `==`. An unknown `type` (or none) without `key` gets no reply.

list.when: The Cave of Many Dreams: `action` selects what to do. The reply always comes as one `game_response` `data` with `interaction: "cave"`, after the async work.

fields.name: action
fields.description: What to do. `enter` opens a run for you and your party (or joins your run again). `info` reads the daily visit state. The others need an open run. A missing or unknown value fails with `invalid_interaction` (after the run check).

fields.name: room
fields.description: `talk` and `buy`: the id of the room.

fields.name: actor
fields.description: `talk`: the id of the actor to talk to. Without it, the server takes the nearest actor that can talk.

fields.name: choice
fields.description: `vote`: the id of the open vote (`choice.id` in the cave state).

fields.name: option
fields.description: `vote`: the id of the option that you vote for.

request.note: `room`, `actor`, `choice` and `option` count only for the `action` that their description names. The format has no variants inside a variant, so the types do not tie them to `action`.

responses.name: Cave entered
responses.when: `action: "enter"`: a new run opened for you and your party, or you joined your run again. The reply comes after the async work, so other events can arrive first.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

fields.name: run
fields.description: The key of the run (24 hex characters).

fields.name: expires
fields.description: When the run ends, in ms since 1970. A new run lasts 24 minutes.

fields.name: level
fields.description: The level of the run, the highest level in the party.

fields.name: resumed
fields.description: You joined your run again after a disconnect.

responses.name: Cave visit
responses.when: `action: "info"`: the daily visit state. It works without a run.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

confirm.live_needed: `resume` and `unlimited` depend on the run and the database state of the account.

responses.name: Cave exited
responses.when: `action: "exit"`: you left the run. The server settles the purse of the run first.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

responses.name: Cave state
responses.when: `action: "state"`. Also `talk` to an encounter (the server opens its vote), and `talk` while the run is paused (the state of the vote, not a chat).

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

fields.name: state
fields.description: The snapshot of the run (`cave_snapshot`), the same object as `state` in the [`cave`](#recv-cave) event.

confirm.live_needed: The snapshot (`cave_snapshot`) is built from the live state of the run.

responses.name: Cave chat
responses.when: `action: "talk"` to a traveler (a `citizen` room). The traveler stops for 4 s and faces you.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

confirm.live_needed: `skin`, `cx` and the line come from the traveler that the run picked.

responses.name: Cave voted
responses.when: `action: "vote"`: the server counted your vote, or you voted for `option` already (then the reply has no `result`).

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

fields.name: resolved
fields.description: `true` when the vote has a result.

fields.name: result
fields.description: The id of the option that won (`"fallback"` when none won), when the vote is resolved. Not sent when you vote again for the same option.

responses.name: Cave bought
responses.when: `action: "buy"`: the item of the room's merchant went to a member of the run. The server takes the price from the gold of the run.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

fields.name: recipient
fields.description: The member that got the item.

fields.name: gold
fields.description: The price, taken from the gold of the run.

failures.intro: Every failure is `{response: "data", place: "interaction", interaction: "cave", request_id, failed: true, reason}`: the server catches the error of the action and sends its message as `reason`. Only the checks of the action in `action` run.

rows.when: `enter`: the run cannot open or you cannot join it again. `reason` is the message of the error: one of the values in the type, or the message of another error.

extra.name: reason
extra.description: Why. `cant_enter`: you are dead, not on `main`, or cannot walk. `bring_party_to_keeper`: a member is not within 160 px of the keeper at (816, 1200) on `main`, is in a fight, or uses an old client. `party_too_large`: more than 3 members.

confirm.note: Any other error of the async work arrives as its message

rows.when: An action other than `enter` and `info`: you have no open run, you left it, or it expired.

extra.name: request_id
extra.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

rows.when: `talk`: you are dead (and the run is not paused).

extra.name: request_id
extra.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

rows.when: `talk`: no actor that can talk is in `room` on your map, or it is more than 160 px from you.

extra.name: request_id
extra.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

rows.when: `buy` or an unknown action: you are dead.

extra.name: request_id
extra.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

rows.when: `vote`: no open vote, `choice` is not its id, or you are not a voter. If you voted for `option` already, the server sends the vote again as a success instead.

extra.name: request_id
extra.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

rows.when: `vote`: the vote has a result, or its time ended.

extra.name: request_id
extra.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

rows.when: `vote`: `option` is not an option of the vote.

extra.name: request_id
extra.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

rows.when: `vote`: you voted for another option already.

extra.name: request_id
extra.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

rows.when: `buy`: the room has no stock, it is sold, or its merchant is dead.

extra.name: request_id
extra.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

rows.when: `buy`: you are not on the map of the room, or more than 160 px from its merchant.

extra.name: request_id
extra.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

rows.when: `buy`: the gold of the run is less than the price.

extra.name: request_id
extra.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

rows.when: An unknown `action` (or none).

extra.name: request_id
extra.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

also.to: you, or the members of the run
also.when: `cave` `talk` sends `{type: "chat", state, chat}` (a traveler) or `{type: "choice", state}` to you before the reply. `exit` sends `{type: "ended", reason: "exit", state}` to you. `enter`, `vote` and `buy` publish a new state to the members of the run.
`cave` `enter` succeeds: the server moves each member to the first floor (or you to your saved place when you join again), before the reply. `exit` moves you out.
also.summary: The new map. See the [`new_map`](#recv-new_map) entry.

confirm.live_needed: `new_map` is built by `transport_player_to`; its fields depend on the floor map of the run.

also.when: `cave` `enter` fails after the enter animation started.
`cave` `enter`: when the enter animation starts (before the 1.8 s wait), each member gets its own state. `buy` also sends you your state, before the new `cave` state.
also.summary: Your character, stopped for the enter animation; for `buy`, after the item went out.

also.when: `cave` `enter`: the enter animation starts (a new run, or joining your run again), before the 1.8 s wait.

enter: `player` to each member, and `ui` `cave_enter` to clients nearby (the animation)
`new_map` to each member (the first floor), or to you (your saved place)
`cave` state to the members of the run
info, state, vote, buy: for `vote` and `buy`: `cave` state to the members of the run

list.when: Calls the cavalry to your fight. You need a `tracker` in your inventory.

responses.name: Cavalry
responses.when: The call succeeds. The server always sends one object: this one, or the failure with `failed: true` and `reason`.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: The `request_id` of the request, when it had one.

fields.name: queued
fields.description: `true` when no cavalry member is free now, so the call waits.

fields.name: assigned
fields.description: The cavalry members that go to your fight now.

fields.name: next_call
fields.description: When the account can call again, in ms since 1970.

fields.name: cooldown_ms
fields.description: `next_call` minus now, at least 0. Present when `next_call` is.

fields.name: phrase_args
fields.description: The values for the phrase: `{}` here.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The English text of the phrase.

confirm.live_needed: `assigned`, `next_call` and the English `message` depend on the live cavalry state and the language files.

rows.when: The call fails. `unavailable`: cavalry is off, you have no account, a call of your account is in progress, or an error. `tracker`: no `tracker` item in your inventory. `location`: no instance, or a generated map. `cooldown`: the account called less than its cooldown ago. `no_monsters`: no eligible monster near you. `guarded`: a level-80+ player is within 150 px of the monsters.

extra.name: next_call
extra.description: `cooldown`: when the account can call again, in ms since 1970.

extra.name: message
extra.description: The English text of the phrase.
extra.example: Cavalry can answer again in 21 min.

confirm.live_needed: Which `reason` and phrase come back depends on the live cavalry state; the `phrase_args` of `not_threatened` come from the error of `cavalry_reserve`.

list.when: Reads the status of the market patron (Merrit) for you.

responses.name: Market patron
responses.when: Your last `merrit_info` is more than 3 s ago. The reply comes after a database read. If the read fails, the payload is `{reasons: [{code: "unavailable"}]}`.
responses.summary: The status of the market patron for you (`market_patron_public_status`), with `account_last`: the last receipt of the account, or `null`.

account_last.name: Merchant
account_last.reason: Your shop stayed stocked for two minutes and left the neighbors room.

confirm.live_needed: The status fields come from `market_patron_status`, and `account_last` is a stored receipt from the database.

order: `merrit_status` to you, after a database read

rows.when: Your last `merrit_info` is less than 3 s ago.

list.when: Asks Rook (`citizen17`) on `desertland` for the way to an NPC. At most 1 request per 10 s.

fields.name: destination
fields.description: The NPC on `desertland` that Rook shows the way to. A missing or other value fails with `distance`.

responses.name: Route
responses.when: The route is valid. Rook walks 24 px toward the NPC (when he is not walking already).

fields.name: from
fields.description: The position of Rook now: `[x, y]`.

fields.name: to
fields.description: The position of the NPC on `desertland` from G: `[x, y]`.

responses.name: Route done
responses.when: Sent last, only when the request has `request_id`.

rows.when: You are not on `desertland`, Rook (`citizen17`) is not in your instance or is more than 160 px from you, or `destination` is not valid. The reply is the bare string, also with `request_id`.
Your last `citizen_route` is less than 10 s ago.

example.message: Rook is still reading the sands.
Rook marks the first steps toward Smith.

list.when: The new-year tree: gives `holidayspirit`, and a `funtoken` when you did not have the condition.

responses.name: Tree condition
responses.when: The tree gave you `holidayspirit`. Before the **Tree done** reply.
responses.summary: Your state with `holidayspirit` in `s` (24 h, `G.conditions.holidayspirit.duration`), and `hitchhikers` with the `game_response` `{response: "condition", name: "holidayspirit", cevent: true, duration}` of `add_condition`. With `reopen: true` when the tree gave you a `funtoken`.

responses.name: Tree done
responses.when: Sent last, only when the request has `request_id`.

fields.name: received_token
fields.description: `true` when you got a `funtoken`. You get one when you did not have `holidayspirit` and you have a free slot.

rows.when: Your map has no `newyear_tree` ref, or you are more than 300 px from it. G 17478 has no `newyear_tree` ref on any map.

list.name: orb
list.when: An orb: removes the other orb conditions and adds this one. No `game_response` on success.

responses.name: Orb condition
responses.when: Success. It is the only reply, also with `request_id`.
responses.summary: Your state without the four orb conditions in `s`. The server then calls `add_condition` with the orb, but G 17478 has no orb in `G.conditions`, so it adds nothing (node/server_functions.js:3237-3240).

rows.when: Your map has no ref for that orb, or you are more than 40 px from it. G 17478 has no orb ref on any map. The reply is the bare string, also with `request_id`.

list.when: The lever on `resort_e`: takes you to `resort` (a `magiport` of 300 ms).

responses.name: Lever condition
responses.when: Success: `s.magiport` (300 ms) to `resort` starts. Before the **Lever done** reply.

responses.name: Lever done
responses.when: Sent last, only when the request has `request_id`.

rows.when: You are not on `resort_e`.

list.name: Lever (bare)
list.when: The payload is the bare string `"the_lever"` (`data == "the_lever"`). It has no `request_id`, so the forms without `request_id` apply.
The daily task board: starts a 1 hour monster hunt for goo. G 17478 has no `dailytask` ref, so it always fails with `distance`.

responses.name: Daily task
responses.when: You are within 150 px of `G.maps.main.ref.dailytask`. The server sets `p.monsterhunt` to goo for 1 hour.

confirm.live_needed: G 17478 has no `G.maps.main.ref.dailytask`, so this reply cannot happen with that G.

rows.when: `G.maps.main.ref.dailytask` is missing (as in G 17478), or you are more than 150 px from it. The reply is the bare string, also with `request_id`.

list.name: Konami
list.when: The end of the konami sequence. Send `move` with `key` `u`, `u`, `d`, `d`, `l`, `r`, `l`, `r`, then this event with `key: "B"`, then with `key: "A"`.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The konami key. The server reads it only when `player.konami` exists (a [`move`](#send-move) with `key` makes it). `B` adds to the list; `A` checks it.

responses.name: Konami B
responses.when: `key: "B"`, and the list has fewer than 20 entries: the server adds `B` to `player.konami` and sends nothing.

responses.name: Konami
responses.when: `key: "A"` and `player.konami` holds `uuddlrlrB`. Your temporary skin becomes `konami` (you get `player` first). The monster is `p.target_lock`. The server picks a new one when it has none, or the last pick is more than 15 days old.

fields.name: monster
fields.description: A key of `G.monsters`: a monster that is not special, not stationary, and has `c`.

confirm.note: The monster is picked from G at run time

rows.when: `key` is `B` and the list has 20 entries, `key` is neither `A` nor `B`, or no `player.konami`.
`A`, and `player.konami` is not `uuddlrlrB`. The server clears the list.
No character.

extra.name: interaction
extra.description: The `type` of the request, as sent. Absent when the request had no `type`.

confirm.note: Without `request_id` the handler returns and sends nothing; live, a socket with no character got no reply
